items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The night I met Bud, he heard me with Willie Wells and a guys playing his song

ctx.x: You are, you is, but you’re my children (Laughs) whatever you are or is.

It was the same thing but he had to tell the brother in a different way so he can understand it so he can get the gist of where he was coming from. So, that little burst kind of keeps me in check. But, I did… And you know, the funny thing about it, they got him looking at this saxophone and there wasn't a saxophone player within miles of where we were. But, they got a saxophone that. That's what it is. He played all these things, keeping the grooves and some solos. He kept all this simple. If you look at it,…
